instance_name.description: Name used to identify this Tarantool instance in logs, metrics, and CLI output.

work_dir.description: Base directory for instance data, logs, and backups (must be writable).

read_only.description: If true, this instance is read-only (e.g., replica). Prevents writes to box.space.

listen_host.description: IP address to bind the client API to (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

listen_port.description: Port number for the Tarantool client API (default 3301).

replicas.description: List of replication source URIs (used for multi-master or replica setups).

log_nonblock.description: If true, logs are written asynchronously to avoid blocking.

memtx_memory.description: Maximum memory (in bytes) for memtx engine (in-memory tuples). Default: 256 MB.

memtx_min_tuple_size.description: Minimum tuple size (in bytes) that memtx allocates (tuning for tiny tuples).

memtx_max_tuple_size.description: Maximum tuple size (in bytes) allowed in memtx engine (default: 1 MB).

vinyl_memory.description: Maximum memory (in bytes) for vinyl engine’s read/write cache (disk-backed).

vinyl_cache.description: Size (in bytes) of the vinyl cache for B-trees (read-only).

vinyl_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for vinyl background operations (e.g., compaction).

snapshot_by_xlog.description: If true, snapshot is triggered on XLog rotation (instead of time-based).

snapshot_interval.description: Time (in seconds) between automatic snapshots (default: 30 min).

snapshot_count.description: Number of snapshots retained (older ones are purged).

snapshot_in_background.description: If true, snapshots run in background (non-blocking).

replication_synchro_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) to wait for synchronous replication quorum.

replication_synchro_quorum.description: Number of successful synchronous replicas required for commit quorum.

checkpoint_interval.description: Time (in seconds) between automatic checkpoints (default: 15 min).

quota.description: Disk write quota (in bytes) — limits total WAL + snapshot disk usage.

replication_id.description: Unique cluster-wide ID for this instance (required in multi-master clusters).

replication_connect_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) before retrying replication connection.

replication_connect_quorum.description: Number of successful connections to replication sources before starting.

replication_skip_conflict.description: If true, conflicts from multi-master replication are silently skipped.

spaces.description: Optional list of spaces to pre-create with default settings (useful for apps with static schema).

primary_parts.description: Index parts definition (e.g., [[1, 'num']] for first field as number).

is_unique.description: Whether the primary index enforces uniqueness.
